name: Aholah
description: Woman living at the time of Exile and Return

points: The elder is Aholah and her sister is Aholibah; they were the Most High's and bare sons and daughters. Aholah is Samaria, the northern kingdom, and Aholibah is Jerusalem, the southern kingdom.

note.label: Ezekiel 23: Aholah and Aholibah, the Two Harlot Sisters
